dismissed.title: Preserve the shopper's message whitespace
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. Treating whitespace-only text as clearing is a reasonable reading of AC3 ('clear the text'), and the server-side normalization and 60-character check back AC6. No ticket line is contradicted, so the scope row is not an unmet requirement.

dismissed.title: Mobile ClientApp's own basket.proto drops gift messages on every bag update
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The mobile ClientApp compiles its own copy of basket.proto, which this PR does not touch. Its calls are still accepted, as the story requires, but they erase messages. This is a gap in another client, outside this PR's scope.

dismissed.title: Opening the gift message editor shifts the quantity/remove/total columns
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The other columns re-centre vertically while the editor is open, but the line without a message still looks as before (AC1). This is a layout preference with no mockup behind it.

dismissed.title: Disclosure toggle gives no cancel/close affordance once open
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. No ticket line asks for a cancel control, and clicking the native <details> toggle again closes it. Preference.

dismissed.title: No video shows a bag saved before this change (AC7)
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The TC-GIFT-1-12 functional test (legacy basket JSON without GiftMessage loads and maps to no message) verifies AC7, and the acceptance lens rated AC7 met. A video of a seeded old bag is optional.
